Question
========
Inequality between ethnic groups in a country is an example of ...

Answerlist
----------
* horizontal inequality
* vertical inequality
* absolute inequality
* between-country inequality

Solution
========
Horizontal inequalities are inequalities between culturally defined groups (Stewart 2005); vertical inequality is among individuals or households.

Answerlist
----------
* True
* False
* False
* False
